doctrineConflicts.title: Public beta score doctrine conflicts with formal evidence artifacts
doctrineConflicts.description: The score doctrine says the score is deterministic, but the current runner still uses boolean/string-derived inputs while formal evidence artifacts exist.
evidence: score runner still has hasTargetedBehaviorEvidence: false, provider smoke launch-report string parsing, debug-entry admin truth scoring, and visual file-existence scoring.
doctrineConflicts.recommendedAction: Keep the doctrine but update it with a strict artifact-ingestion contract when the score evidence fix lands.

doctrineConflicts.title: Launch readiness language can outpace missing smoke evidence
doctrineConflicts.description: Launch-readiness docs and reports can use launchable/final language while provider/runtime/admin truth evidence artifacts remain missing or unverified.
evidence: provider/runtime/admin truth evidence reports are tracked separately and must not be overridden by launchable wording.
doctrineConflicts.recommendedAction: Reconcile launch-readiness docs with the score evidence artifact contract and keep final launch wording capped by formal smoke evidence.

doctrineConflicts.title: Generated report snapshot doctrine is split across docs and validators
doctrineConflicts.description: The repo says generated reports are snapshots, but score, Admin Debug, and launch readiness still consume generated reports in ways that can look authoritative when stale.
evidence: AGENTS says generated reports are evidence snapshots and stale after 24 hours unless a contract says otherwise.
doctrineConflicts.recommendedAction: Add one reusable snapshot-consumption rule for score, launch readiness, and Admin Debug generated-report cards.

doctrineConflicts.title: Admin Debug doctrine overlaps score and admin analytics truth lanes
doctrineConflicts.description: Admin Debug is the control tower, but its generated-report cards overlap score and analytics truth lanes without one visible ownership boundary.
evidence: Control Tower reads many generated reports, while score truth and analytics truth keep separate validators.
doctrineConflicts.recommendedAction: Split Admin Debug display inventory from canonical score/analytics ownership in the spring-cleaning follow-up.

doctrineConflicts.title: Watch-time doctrine is canonical but tests still encode legacy duration as watch time
doctrineConflicts.description: The watch-time doctrine defines canonical rollup semantics, but a metrics snapshot test still expects page-duration/watchSecondsTotal as canonical watch time.
evidence: tests/unit/admin-user-metrics.spec.ts fixture still uses watchSecondsTotal as expected watchTimeMs.
doctrineConflicts.recommendedAction: Keep the canonical rollup and add a cleanup section for legacy diagnostic duration tests.

doctrineConflicts.title: Release-note doctrine should remain the current Beta badge authority
doctrineConflicts.description: Release notes have a clear public-beta badge contract and should be kept as the current authority while this inventory is added.
evidence: This patch updates the Beta badge through the release-note lane instead of inventing a separate UI truth.
doctrineConflicts.recommendedAction: Keep release-note doctrine intact; only publish the required Beta badge note for this inventory patch.

validatorConflicts.title: Beta score validators overlap without enforcing formal artifact ingestion
validatorConflicts.description: Phase-one triage proves the evidence artifacts exist, but the public beta score validator still allows the old boolean/string path.
validatorConflicts.recommendedAction: Move the phase-one evidence-ingestion assertions into the canonical beta score validator when the score fix lands.

validatorConflicts.title: Codebase junk cleanup validation only proves labels exist
validatorConflicts.description: The existing junk cleanup validator checks for report fields and label strings, so it can pass while orphan/deprecated candidates stay at zero.
evidence: scan-codebase-junk relies on naming/package-script checks and does not inspect cross-lane conflicts.
validatorConflicts.recommendedAction: Use this spring-cleaning report as the stricter cleanup inventory before any removal/refactor pass.

validatorConflicts.title: Launch readiness validator overlaps score truth and can preserve stale report authority
validatorConflicts.description: Launch readiness remains useful, but it should not be the source for provider smoke scoring or final beta readiness truth.
validatorConflicts.recommendedAction: Keep launch readiness as evidence, but remove it from score provider-smoke authority in the dedicated score evidence fix.

validatorConflicts.title: Release-note validator is string-heavy but has a clear package script and doctrine
validatorConflicts.description: The release-note lane uses string-contract validation, but it is currently the intended Beta badge guardrail and should not be replaced in this pass.
validatorConflicts.recommendedAction: Leave release-note validation intact and update only the required public beta badge artifacts.

validatorConflicts.title: Admin analytics validators can pass while panel display truth drifts
validatorConflicts.description: Admin analytics has many targeted validators, but raw logs, cached summaries, and live cards still need a single display-truth inventory.
evidence: Admin analytics panels mix rawEvents, cached summaries, fallback labels, and live source labels.
validatorConflicts.recommendedAction: Create a panel-by-panel display truth map before consolidating admin analytics validators.

validatorConflicts.title: Creator dashboard validators do not yet require source samples for live stats

validatorConflicts.recommendedAction: Add a source/sample metadata contract to creator settings/dashboard validators before changing UI behavior.

validatorConflicts.title: Package script target scan found no missing TypeScript validator targets

evidence: No missing package-script TypeScript targets found.
validatorConflicts.recommendedAction: Keep using package script ownership as static evidence for validator inventory.
